title: Earlier Barre Studio
summary: The earlier home of the barre studio and Repair Shop, including the decision to retain and refinish an original solid-wood door.
searchSummary: Earlier barre studio evidence from the Home Reno - Studio | Office Flickr album, kept separate from the restored living-room studio.
stage: Earlier barre studio; subsequent room use unspecified

gallery.caption: The stripped original door installed before its separate charred-finish treatment.
The retained wood door within its painted surround.

introduction: This room previously housed the barre studio and Repair Shop. Alongside the room views, selected details follow the choice to keep an original solid-wood door and work its charred surface by hand.
evidenceBoundary: The installed stripped-door photo predates the separate charred-finish treatment. These details do not establish that the finished door was reinstalled. The journal's 2022 heading conflicts with mostly February 2023 Flickr date labels, so the work is not presented as a dated sequence. This earlier studio is separate from the dedicated Office and the restored living-room studio. Its subsequent use is not specified.
